executiveSummary.headline: Correct the Name Error and Clarify the Uvero Alto Resort Offer
executiveSummary.lead: Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana recorded 2.7% AI Consideration and appeared in 13.6% of eligible scenarios, with a 27.3% weighted attribute Reality Gap. These results do not establish why the hotel was or was not mentioned. The first action is a verified accuracy correction: official overview body text contains “Wyndham Alltra Puna Cana.” After fixing the missing “t,” the hotel should consistently present its Uvero Alto Beach location, 620-room all-inclusive inventory, 20 dining and beverage venues, family facilities, spa terms, and three-venue meetings offer—without introducing out-of-scope Cap Cana Marina claims.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of 236 comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of 59 eligible scenarios where it appeared. Reality Gap is a weighted attribute-recognition diagnostic covering 33 tested attributes. None represents bookings, revenue, rank, or traveler exposure.

executiveSummary.closing: The hotel has substantial verified inventory and facilities. The practical task is to correct the official name error, organize those strengths around the true Uvero Alto location, prevent geography drift, and maintain transparent fee and award disclosures. Future movement should be measured without promising rankings, bookings, or revenue. Digital authority: Destination authority requires geographic accuracy first.
